name: Tripoli
description: Tripoli (Tripoley) is a multi-phase card game combining Pay Cards, Poker, and a Michigan Rummy (Stops) phase. Players ante chips onto a board with labeled sections. Holders of specific Heart cards collect from those sections. Then a Poker round is played, followed by a Stops/Shedding phase. Descended from the 500-year-old German game Poch.

history.origins: Tripoli (also known as Three in One) is a modern North American adaptation of the ancient European game Poch (Pochspiel), which has been played in Germany for at least 500 years. Poch is documented in 15th-century sources; Thierry Depaulis's article in The Playing-Card details its early history. Tripoli retains Poch's three-phase structure (pay cards, betting, Stops) but uses a standard 52-card deck and fixed heart-suit layout; it is sold in North America as Tripoley, Rummoli, Michigan Rummy, and Royal Rummy, and in Australia as Calliente.
timeline: 20th century: Tripoli/Tripoley and Rummoli sold in North America.
history.evolution: Adapted for North American market with game board.

setup.deck: Standard 52-card deck. Board/mat with labeled sections.
setup.dealing: Deal all cards (one hand is 'dead'). Ante chips to board.

rules.objective: Accumulate the most chips by winning stakes in the Pay Cards phase, the Poker phase, and the Michigan (Stops) phase; the player with the most chips when the game ends wins.
rules.gameplay: Phase 1: Pay Cards â€” Heart holders collect. Phase 2: Poker â€” Pick 5 from hand, bet/fold. Phase 3: Michigan Rummy â€” Play ascending sequences by suit; first out wins Kitty + chips per card left in opponents' hands.
keyRules: Unclaimed chips roll to next round

strategy.basic: Ante wisely. Play strong poker hands. Shed low cards in Phase 3.
strategy.intermediate: Remember what's in the dead hand (stops).
strategy.advanced: Manage stop cards to control Phase 3.

variations.name: Rummoli style (collect in Michigan)
variations.description: Omit stage one; layout stakes are collected by anyone who plays the relevant card during the Michigan stage (e.g. play king and queen of hearts consecutively for king-queen stake; play 8-9-10 in one suit consecutively for that stake).
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Rule change only; no engine constant overrides.

variations.name: Bid for pay suit
variations.description: Players bid for the right to choose the pay suit; high bidder adds the bid to the kitty and chooses the suit. Stakes on pay cards are collected during the Michigan stage.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Rule change only; no engine constant overrides.

scoring.description: Chips won across all phases. Unclaimed sections roll over.
scoring.winCondition: Win the most chips across 3 phases.
